meta.frame: operator: origin rear mount, +Z front, +Y up, +X operator right

compartments.label: Optical path
compartments.notes: Cylinder along Z; zoom cam barrel with 16.5/170/230 scale lives in the front half (photo 065246).

compartments.label: Door, operator left (SYSTEM UNIT 338A)
compartments.notes: Hinged panel carrying B1-B4 on 5409.78 card edges. Silkscreen map on inside is rotated 180 deg relative to photo 065650.

compartments.label: Left bay, behind door
compartments.notes: B5 system board, B6, B7 terminal board, B8/B9 power transistors, harness trunk.

compartments.label: Right bay (POWER UNIT 110A)
compartments.notes: Fuses F1-F4 + spares, toroid 16V/240V/25V, can caps, EXT AUTO-MANU and LAMP ON-OFF toggles.

compartments.label: Front bay (zoom barrel, motors, sensor boards)
compartments.notes: Photo 065246. LENS/CAMERA toggle board (B20), barrel sensor board (B21), brass motor and pots.

compartments.label: Bottom (not yet photographed)
compartments.notes: Alex: more connectors here. Place and photograph.

objects.label: +/-13V regulator
objects.notes: Relays RL1/RL2 (7921), diodes D1-D8, 4x 100uF, two TO-220.

objects.label: Turret motor assembly
objects.notes: Not yet identified in photos. Suggests ES variant with 2x extender turret.

objects.label: Iris motor assembly
objects.notes: Brass motor at the bottom of the zoom barrel (photo 065307).

objects.label: Turret auto/manual switch
objects.notes: May be the EXT AUTO-MANU toggle on the power unit.

objects.label: Pattern projector enable switch
objects.notes: May be the LAMP ON-OFF toggle on the power unit.

objects.label: Iris amplifier
objects.notes: JRC 4558D, quad op-amp, VR1-4, two TO-220 outputs.

objects.label: LENS / CAMERA switch board
objects.notes: IC1, D1-D4, R1-R3, VR1, toggle LENS/CAMERA (photo 065307).

objects.label: Barrel sensor board
objects.notes: Long narrow board beside the zoom barrel (photo 065246).

objects.label: Ext set signal generator
objects.notes: 12 CMOS DIPs (MC14011B, MC14001B, MC14002B, CD4071BE). Board-number assignment is a hypothesis; confirm from stencil at card edge.

objects.label: Digital comparator
objects.notes: CMOS + trimpots VR1-3 (MC14070B, MC14016B).

objects.label: System board (zoom/focus servo)
objects.notes: OP-05 cans, OP-02, AD7512DIKN, VR1-VR17, T1-T32. Blue/red edge connector = CN105.

objects.label: Power regulator PC board
objects.notes: Small board on 5403.793 socket, 4 trimpots, two 14-pin DIPs.

objects.label: B6 card edge (5403.793)
objects.notes: 15 fingers.

objects.label: Terminal board
objects.notes: Pads labelled with the camera interface signals (photo 065258).

objects.label: Power transistor assembly A
objects.notes: Four screw-mounted transistors on black heatsink block.

objects.label: Power transistor assembly B
objects.notes: Location unconfirmed.

objects.label: Rear 50-pin camera connector
objects.notes: Pinout unknown. Number pins with keyway at 12 o'clock, rows top to bottom, left to right; record the scheme used.

objects.label: CN101
objects.notes: On silkscreen map near CN112 and CN105; location not yet found.

objects.label: CN104
objects.notes: Near B6 on map.

objects.label: System board edge connector (blue/red)
objects.notes: About 36 positions, double-sided.

objects.label: Door card edge under B1
objects.notes: 5409.78 socket; 15 numbered + A-S lettered fingers. Board-to-CN mapping from silkscreen map, GUESS.

objects.label: CN110
objects.notes: At terminal-board end on map.

objects.label: CN111
objects.notes: Not on the map; possibly on the bottom.

objects.label: Power unit
objects.notes: Toroid, fuses, cans, 1.8 ohm 2XL resistor, feed-through terminals.

viewRequests.question: Which physical board carries which stencil number? I assigned B3 top-left, B4 top-right, B2 bottom-left, B1 bottom-right by component type. Please confirm from the number printed near each card edge.
Photograph the CAM50 face with the keyway visible and tell me the numbering scheme you used, so the placeholder grid can be corrected.
The toroid is marked 240V. Is that a primary tap (mains into the lens) or a secondary? Trace the toroid leads to the fuse block and to CAM50 before any power goes on.
